# ADR-001: Use a process-local cache

## Status

Accepted

## Context

Recomputation dominates latency and a shared cache is warranted.

## Decision

We adopt a process-local LRU with a write-through path.

## Alternatives

- A distributed cache (rejected: operational cost).
- No cache (rejected: latency).

## Consequences

Memory pressure rises; cross-region consistency is out of scope.
